# optimizelycmp Provider

Manage Optimizely CMP via its REST API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    optimizelycmp = {
      source = "willemharingopti/optimizelycmp" # replace with your registry address
    }
  }
}

# Credentials are read from the environment (recommended; keeps the secret out of config and state):
#   export OPTIMIZELY_CMP_CLIENT_ID=...
#   export OPTIMIZELY_CMP_CLIENT_SECRET=...
#   export OPTIMIZELY_CMP_BASE_URL=https://api.cmp.optimizely.com   # optional
provider "optimizelycmp" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) API host, https only; the /v3 version is added for you. Env: OPTIMIZELY_CMP_BASE_URL. Default https://api.cmp.optimizely.com
- `client_id` (String) API client ID. Env: OPTIMIZELY_CMP_CLIENT_ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) API client secret. Prefer env OPTIMIZELY_CMP_CLIENT_SECRET so it stays out of config/state.
- `token_url` (String) OAuth token URL (https only). Env: OPTIMIZELY_CMP_TOKEN_URL. Default https://accounts.cmp.optimizely.com/o/oauth2/v1/token
